additional_info.body:
Dear Malek DRIF,
We have completed our review of the logs related to the outlet offline incident. Our findings indicate that the outlet was offline due to a communication outage lasting approximately 5001 ms.
There were no error flags or error codes present in the logs. The system status only showed:
"NoError Unavailable."
Please let us know if you have any further questions or if we can assist you with anything else.
